### Highlights

- **Large files via Lufi (desktop).** Attach → Large file encrypts the file on your device, uploads it to a Lufi server (default upload.disroot.org) through your proxy, and posts a download link. Recipients without Velta can open it in any browser. Expiry, burn-after-reading and delete-from-server are supported.
- **Send directly.** Attach → Send directly (both online) sends a file peer-to-peer through a built-in mini-app, without the relay. Webxdc apps can now use realtime channels.
- **Reactions.** Tap your own reaction to remove it; picking another emoji replaces it.
- **Hashtags.** `#tags` in messages are tappable and search the current chat.
- **Recent commands.** Typing `/` shows the commands you sent recently in that chat.
- **Link previews use your proxy.** Previews fetch through the configured SOCKS5/HTTP proxy or the DNS tunnel, and are skipped instead of going direct if the proxy fails.

### Fixes

- Chat list times use calendar days: today's time, "Yesterday", a weekday up to 6 days back, then the date.
- The account switcher in the drawer no longer closes by itself while accounts load.
- Browser/PWA: a new profile picture survives a reload right after it is set.
- The splash version line stays pinned above the App log bar.
- Android APK no longer bundles Material Components (smaller APK).
- In-memory caches are bounded, so long sessions use less memory.
